# Swashbuckle upgrade

- Upgraded Swashbuckle.AspNetCore from 8.1.1 to 11.0.1 and adapted OpenAPI namespaces and custom schema/operation filters to Microsoft.OpenApi 3.11.0, including reference resolution through the schema repository and JSON node values. The web project builds.
- Started the updated host and compared all seven versioned Swagger documents to the captured pre-upgrade JSON, excluding only the dynamic build-time info description. All were HTTP 200; routes, schemas, operation and response metadata matched. Each document now includes an additional top-level `tags` array generated by the newer library; this is a documented output difference.
- The comparison is a local snapshot check, not a persistent regression test; downstream clients and deployed Swagger UI have not been validated.
